title: Zer0pa Synthetic Biology Pipeline (zer0pa-synbio) v0.1.0
description: In silico metabolic-pathway-engineering pipeline (L1 to L7 plus L4.5 and L5_OED) producing predicted pathways, KPIs, and SBOL3-attested genetic-modification specs as research artifacts. Trains a Conditional Enzyme Kinetics Model (CEKM) on real corpora; runs the four-tool L4 kinetics ensemble plus eQuilibrator MDF / COBRApy FBA / FluxGAT essentiality; scaffolds the L4.5 unknown-enzyme path with RFdiffusion2 + MACE-OFF + ESMFold. Validation triple: Human Milk Oligosaccharide (HMO) seeds 2'-fucosyllactose / 3'-sialyllactose / disialyllacto-N-tetraose in E. coli iML1515 (3/3 PASS under synbio audit verify).
